title: NotionUI Lib
features:
clean UI thats now a UI lib 

Basic Usage

local Window = NotionUI.new({
    Title = "My Script",
    Subtitle = "ready",
    Width = 560,
    Height = 350,
})

local Main = Window:AddTab("Main")
local Section = Main:AddSection("General")

Section:AddLabel("Hello from NotionUI")
Section:AddButton({
    Name = "Button",
    Callback = function()
        print("Pressed")
    end,
})

Main:Select()

For every window option, theme value, component, callback and returned method, see Documentation.md.
https://github.com/okdude42/notionui-lib/tree/main
